claims.statement: The quest guide page at /[slug] and the /sistema catalog render the design system components; the guide page uses the breadcrumb, quest header, guide body, steps, next quest card and the PageEnhancements island.

Button variants never use a color as a fill: primary is a 1.5px --color-accent outline with accent text that fills with --color-raised on hover, secondary is a raised fill and ghost has none; compact makes the primary 40px instead of 44px.

The hit-target class adds a transparent, vertically centered ::after at least 40px tall, or 44px under pointer: coarse, enlarging the click target without changing the drawing; buttons, linked tag pills and checkboxes use it.

Picture renders an AVIF source when available and a WebP img with explicit width and height, writes srcset and sizes in both formats when narrower widths exist, and is lazy-loaded by default, with fetchPriority high and no lazy loading when priority is set.

Figure wraps the image in a link to the uploaded original, or to the widest WebP without one, carrying data-image-viewer and the original's data-image-width and data-image-height, with an accessible name 'Ver imagen a pantalla completa: {alt}' that drops the alt part when the alt is empty.
game.css reads mode-dependent values from variables theme.css sets on [data-mode] rather than from an ancestor selector, so a light section inside a dark page uses light values.
AchievementChain renders the current quest as text with aria-current=page and the others as links, inside an ordered list trimmed by chainWindow.

VideoFacade renders a YouTube video as a link to the watch URL carrying the youtube-nocookie embed URL and title in data attributes, over our own poster or the title, and falls back to a plain link when the stored URL is not a YouTube video.

CoordinatesChip shows a pin icon and [x,y] with data-copy set to /travel x,y and a copy label, CoordinatesText turns every [x,y] in a prose string into a chip, and TravelButton is a compact primary button that copies the start position's travel command.

PageEnhancements is the only client island of these components; it turns every [data-copy] element into a focusable button named from data-copy-label and handles clicks with one delegated document listener.

Copying writes the data-copy value to the clipboard on click or on Enter or Space, shows 'Copiado: {value}' in a role=status toast and marks the element data-copied for 1.6 seconds, or shows the element's data-copy-failed message or 'Escribe {command} en el chat' when the clipboard write fails.

A click without modifier keys on a video facade link inserts a youtube-nocookie iframe after it and focuses it, making the link inert so it stays under the player; with a modifier key the link behaves normally.

A click without modifier keys on a figure link opens a native dialog with showModal that copies the nearest data-theme and data-mode, shows the image with its caption and a Cerrar button, closes on Escape, the button or a click on the dialog itself, and returns focus to the opening link.

travelCommand writes /travel x,y, formatCoordinates writes [x,y], parseCoordinates accepts only a text that is exactly two signed integers of up to three digits in brackets, and splitCoordinates splits prose into text and coordinates in order.

formatAmount separates thousands with a narrow no-break space, and chainWindow keeps chains of five or fewer whole and otherwise keeps the first, previous, current, next and last quests with null marking each gap.
youtubeEmbedUrl builds a youtube-nocookie.com embed URL with autoplay=1 and youtubeWatchUrl builds a youtube.com watch URL.
Vitest includes .test.tsx files so the component tests that render with renderToStaticMarkup run in the unit suite.

QuestHeader renders the guide title, a subtitle with zone, level and 'Misión N de M' without a link, an 'Empieza con' start line with the quest giver's name and start coordinates chip, the giver render on its own when present, and the Prerrequisitos, Necesitarás and Recompensas parts through QuestFacts, omitting anything without data.
The quest giver picture uses the left-facing render below 36rem and the right-facing render above, with an empty alt; the NPC name is text in the header's start line.

IconWell draws one of seven fixed game icons, stored as WebP under public/img/game, at 34 pixels or its smaller file size, sized in rem through --icon so it grows with the root font without exceeding the file size, or an item image, and leaves the well empty without an icon.
QuestSteps renders steps as an ordered list of data-step items with their anchors and an optional coordinates pin, without numbers, titles or checkboxes, labelled by a visually hidden heading.
GuideBlocks renders rich text, figures, videos, fight blocks, warning callouts and tip callouts as TorreTips, with headings starting at h3 inside steps and h4 inside callouts.

GuideRichText turns [x,y] into coordinates chips except inside links or code, keeps only http, https, mailto and same-site links, clamps heading levels to a minimum, and gives priority only to the first uploaded image when asked.

Emblem draws the brand emblem as a decorative SVG with the hat in the accent color, the glyph in the background color and the face in the ink color, and its simple variant keeps only the hat and the grin.
Callout renders a role note aside labelled by its own heading, with default titles Consejo, ¡Importante! and ¡Alto!.
Amount separates thousands with a narrow no-break space U+202F in its own span so figures never wrap, with its styles in globals.css because the site header uses it on every page.

The rewards bag is a disclosure whose state lives in its button's aria-expanded: the island toggles it on click and closes it on a click outside, when focus leaves it, or on Escape, returning focus to the button.

QuestFacts puts reward items in a bag disclosure button with the game bag icon and an item count, whose list shows open without JavaScript and starts closed when data-js is set; the achievement page reuses QuestFacts with its own column titles.
FightBlock renders one row per monster with its image in a 52px well drawn at 42px and '1 × Name', leaving the well empty without an imported image.
NextQuestCard makes the whole card one link to the next guide with its first screenshot as art, the title, level and giver with coordinates, omitting what is missing.
GuideRichText drops an external link to the old Squarespace site that ends in an empty #, rendering its children as plain prose so coordinates inside it become chips again.
CopyName renders an item name with data-copy set to the name without the quantity, the label 'Copiar {name}' and its own failure message, and ItemChip, ItemSlot and the Necesitarás item rows use it.

QuestFacts renders Necesitarás as a list of items whose names copy themselves followed by a separate list of notes, each rendered only when it has rows, laid out in columns of at least 15rem; notes and the rewards bag copy nothing.

QuestFacts lays its parts in a .facts band inside .qhead__facts, an inline-size container: under 34rem of band width the parts stack, and from 34rem Prerrequisitos and Necesitarás sit side by side with Recompensas below.
A proseVideo block inside guide rich text renders as a VideoFacade with its optional poster, and renders nothing without a URL.
tests/unit/css-units.test.ts fails on px values of 3 or more in hand-written CSS or Tailwind arbitrary classes under src, and on any inline style key that is not a CSS custom property.
Emblem reserves its size with width and height and draws it in rem through the --emblem custom property, so it grows with the root font.
